subject: Campus Peak Week: panel coverage, volunteer pool census & gap tracker
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hiring Leads <hiring-leads@redwood.ai>; Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Campus Peak Week: panel coverage, volunteer pool census & gap tracker

Team —

Campus Peak Week (Oct 18–22) is shaping up to be our biggest on-campus push this year. We need to lock panel coverage and surface a clean volunteer roster so Ops can assign rooms and interviews in Greenhouse. I attached an initial tracker with current gaps and a volunteer census export from last year.

Asks:
- Please review the tracker and add your volunteer names and preferred slots by EOD Friday (column: "Volunteer/Shadow").
- If you can commit to >=6 panels that week mark "Primary"; otherwise mark "Shadow/Backup". We try to keep fill ratios at 1.4 panels per interviewer/day during peak.
- If you need swaps or have blackout dates, flag them in the tracker and add a short note here.

Key constraints:
- Product interviews should prioritize Senior/Principled hires; infra and infra-adjacent engineers can flex to backend/system roles.
- We want at least two interviewers with assessment experience per candidate for IC4+.

Attachments: campus_peak_panel_tracker.xlsx (gaps + slot matrix), volunteer_pool_census.csv (historical volunteers), campus-week-calendar.ics (tentative).

I set a short sync on Friday 4pm if we need a live triage. If the sheet shows >10 unfilled slots after sign-ups, we will pull volunteers from partner teams.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Recruiting Lead, Candidate Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hiring Leads <hiring-leads@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campus Peak Week: panel coverage, volunteer pool census & gap tracker

Thanks Marissa — I went through the tracker and added my team's volunteers for the morning slots (backend + infra skill tags). Quick notes:

- I can commit two Primary interviewers (Aisha Rahman, Mateo Alvarez) for Mon/Tue morning and one Shadow (soojin_lee) for Thurs.
- We have three new interviewers that need a quick shadow onboarding (10–15 min), would recommend pairing them with senior interviewers for the first two panels. I added them to the "Shadow onboarding" column.
- For IC4+ panels we should aim to have one Product + one System engineer. I've flagged candidates that need this.

Related: I exported the cohort-level ratios into the sheet; if we keep 1.4 panels/day as you suggested, we will need approximately 18 active volunteer slots across the week (including evenings).

If helpful I can run the volunteer pool census against the hiring channels and send a short prioritized volunteer list.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan | Senior Recruiting Manager

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campus Peak Week: panel coverage, volunteer pool census & gap tracker

Marissa/Priya — I updated the tracker with a few swaps:

- Product panel: I can rotate Markus Klein and Lukas Meyer into two late-morning slots on Wed/Thu. They'll take Senior-level product assessments.
- Backend/Infra: need to confirm with infra leads, but I can cover two evening slots Tue/Wed as Primary.
- Note: Engineering Managers have hiring reviews on Thurs morning — avoid scheduling core leadership interview blocks then. I marked those blackout times in the sheet.

One ask: do we want to include a short "calibration debrief" slot after each day's interviews (15 min) for new interviewers? That would help alignment but requires an additional volunteer for end-of-day coverage.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Staff Engineer (Hiring Liaison)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Campus Peak Week: panel coverage, volunteer pool census & gap tracker

Adding the ops perspective: I synced with Monica and the scheduling team and we can host the calibration debriefs as 15-minute sticky blocks at 5:15pm each day (room A12 and virtual link). Monica has tentatively committed two float interviewers to pick up overflow slots.

Concrete updates I added to the sheet:
- Confirmed volunteers: Jonas Weber (evening Tue), Monica Patel (float/overflow), Markus Klein (Wed late-morning), Lukas Meyer (Thu late-morning)
- Tentative backup list: Naomi Feldman, Ben Carter (marked in volunteer_pool_census.csv)

I've also created a quick calendar event and invited the confirmed volunteers: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=campus-week-2026. Please accept so ops can finalize room assignments.

-Jonas

Subject: Re: Campus Peak Week: panel coverage, volunteer pool census & gap tracker — summary & next steps

Thanks everyone — strong progress. Quick summary and action items:

1) Confirmed Primary volunteers (I copied to sheet): Aisha Rahman, Mateo Alvarez, Markus Klein, Lukas Meyer, Karthik Iyer (evening coverage), Jonas Weber (evening Tue).
2) Shadow/onboarding: Priya to run 15-min shadow sessions for new interviewers Mon/Tue at 3:15pm. Priya to share Zoom link and short checklist.
3) Calibration debriefs: 5:15pm daily (room A12 + virtual). Monica to manage float cover and overflow sign-ups.
4) Ops: Jonas/Monica — please finalize room assignments and push calendar invites for rooms by EOD Monday.
5) Outstanding: if the sheet still shows >8 open slots by Monday noon, we'll pull volunteers from partner teams (Growth and Solutions).

Attachments: final copy of campus_peak_panel_tracker.xlsx (I saved a snapshot with confirmed assignments).

Please reply only with corrections to the assignments (so we keep one-threaded record). If no corrections, I will publish the final roster to Greenhouse and the campus organizers tomorrow morning.

—Marissa
